# Morse Academy

> Learn Morse code in under 15 minutes with microlearning, an AI coach, and gamified practice.

## Pages
- [Dashboard](/): Progress, modules, badges
- [Learn](/learn): Interactive A–Z flashcards with audio
- [Practice](/practice): Adaptive single-letter drill
- [Word Challenge](/word): Decode words at 3 difficulty levels
- [Message Challenge](/message): Decode timed transmissions
- [AI Coach](/coach): Personalized feedback and weak-letter analysis
- [Certification Test](/test): 10-question final exam
